lines.quote: I wrote and maintain the calibration-data management system for Aurinko's instrument test laboratory — roughly 8,000 lines of Python, fully tested, with a PostgreSQL backend and a Flask-based internal web interface. In production since 2018, used daily by the entire test team.

I spent two years (2020–2022) doing hands-on RF characterisation of the L-band front end for the SAR demonstrator: S-parameter measurements on a Keysight PNA-L, antenna-pattern sweeps in Aurinko's compact range, and systematic calibration of the receive chain's gain and noise figure across temperature.

Designed the ground-segment processing pipeline for data from an airborne microwave radiometer flown on a modified King Air B200.

English is the engineering working language at Aurinko; all technical documents, specifications, and design reviews are conducted in English.
